title: Aoi and the Catastrophic First Dash

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: She lunges for the front door with her loafers half on, toast clenched in one hand and her bag in the other.
The reason is painfully simple: she stayed up late ironing the new ribbon for today... and forgot to set her alarm back on after checking it.
I only meant to look at the time...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: She yanks the door open.
A rubber band she tied to keep the mail slot shut overnight snaps free and catapults the stack of newspapers into her face.
Ah—!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: astonished

dialogue.text: She stumbles down the step, windmilling, somehow keeps the toast, then steps straight onto the heel of her own loafer.
Ow... no, keep moving.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: At the corner, relief— the bus is still there.
Wait, please—!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: She sprints, reaches out... and the strap of her schoolbag catches on a campaign banner tied to a pole.
The pole spins. The banner wraps around her like a burrito. The bus pulls away.
...I see.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: serious_expressionless

dialogue.text: Aoi-chan? Are you being kidnapped by civic enthusiasm?
dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Suda

dialogue.text: Mrs. Suda from the neighborhood vegetable shop hustles over, unwinding her with brisk, practiced hands.
Good morning. I'm sorry for... this shape.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: No apologizing. Here, take my bicycle. Coast downhill and fly.
dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Suda

dialogue.text: I haven't ridden one in a while.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Then today you'll remember fast.
dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Suda

dialogue.text: Aoi bows, mounts the bicycle, and pushes off.
For one bright minute, it works. The wind cools her face. The school gate feels possible.
Maybe... maybe I can still make homeroom.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: Then the front basket, overloaded with daikon, tips forward.
A white radish launches out, wedges perfectly into the rotating front wheel, and the bicycle stops with theatrical finality.
Why is there a daikon in the basket...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: She topples gently into a hedge. Leaves in her hair. Ribbon crooked. Silence.
For the first time, she doesn't get up right away.
...This was supposed to be a good start.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sad

dialogue.text: Her eyes sting. Not enough for tears, just enough to blur the school in the distance.
I ironed everything. I checked everything. I really tried.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: holding_back_tears

dialogue.text: Um... are you okay?
dialogue.speaker: Boy at Gate

dialogue.text: A lanky boy in the same uniform stands by the path, holding a fallen name-tag holder she must have dropped.
I'm fine. Just... losing to vegetables.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: holding_back_tears

dialogue.text: Then let's not let the vegetables win. Here.
dialogue.speaker: Boy at Gate

dialogue.text: He offers the holder. Then, after one glance at the jammed wheel, crouches and yanks the daikon free with both hands.
Th-thank you.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: We run now. Explanations later.
dialogue.speaker: Boy at Gate

dialogue.text: Aoi blinks, then lets out the smallest laugh of the morning.
Right. Running sounds simpler than cycling.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: They dash the last stretch together, her bag bouncing, leaves still caught in her hair.
At the school gate, the warning bell rings just as she stumbles across the line.
Made it... somehow.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: First day speedrun. Impressive form.
dialogue.speaker: Boy at Gate

dialogue.text: Please don't tell anyone about the daikon.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Breathless, disheveled, and one disaster away from disaster again, Aoi presses a hand to her crooked ribbon.
It isn't the graceful start she wanted.
But when she looks up, there's a faint smile on her face anyway.
